thread:
maya: Heads up — GH Actions runner flaking on eval-matrix again, started ~10:30am UTC. Several quantize shards are skipping with auth errors.

maya: failing log snippet:

```
Runner: POST /_apis/build/incomingrequests -> 401 Unauthorized
ERROR: token expired / invalid
``` 

dmitri: ugh. still the self-hosted token rotation bug? saw this last month too. which runner labels affected?

maya: labels = `self-hosted && eval-large` mostly. small shards run fine on `ubuntu-latest`.

li: can you paste the full job name? might be the matrix expansion that sets `GHA_RUNNER_LABEL` incorrectly.

maya: job `eval:quantize-matrix` — here's the relevant matrix fragment:

```
matrix:
  shard: [0..7]
  quantize: [true, false]
  runner: ["self-hosted && eval-large", "ubuntu-latest"]
```

sarah: seems like when quantize=true it picks eval-large, but some hosts lost the auth token after autoscaling. deploy-bot showed node termination events around the same time.

deploy-bot: node n-42 terminated (scale-down), last heartbeat 2025-11-10T10:27:11Z :information_source:

dmitri: two immediate fixes:
- stop using `self-hosted` for shards that can run on hosted runners (cost/fragility win)
- add a pre-check step that retries auth on 401 before failing

li: also we should ensure the matrix doesn't drop `runner` env var when expanding. GH Actions merged maps are weird.

maya: Agree. Proposal:
1) change matrix to set `runs-on` per shard via conditional: use hosted for shard ids < 4.
2) add a `runner-health` step that pings the runner token endpoint with 3 retries.
3) update Buildkite nightly to run a full quantize matrix once per night at 03:30 UTC (instead of partial currently).
4) add a lightweight smoke job for PRs that only runs `quantize=false` and 2 sample shards.

li: sgtm. can you paste the GH Actions snippet you'd change? I'll open a small PR.

maya: sure — minimal change:

```
runs-on: ${{ contains(matrix.shard, "0") || matrix.shard < 4 ? 'ubuntu-latest' : 'self-hosted && eval-large' }}
steps:
  - name: runner-health
    run: |
      curl -f -sS $GHA_RUNNER_HEALTH || { sleep 5; curl -f -sS $GHA_RUNNER_HEALTH; }
```

sarah: for the dashboard/alerts: the current eval-reports ingestion assumes artifacts always upload. We should add a job-level `artifact-status` field in the metadata so failures show up in the nightly dashboard and trigger a regression triage if >3 failures/night.

dmitri: agree. also add a tag `ci:pr-smoke` so we can filter PR jobs and not count them in nightly SLO metrics.

eval-bot: new artifact uploaded for 1876543210-eval-quantize-shard-2.tar.gz (size: 12.3MB)

dmitri: FYI I saw a subtle metric mismatch in `accuracy.delta` — the eval harness reports a floating precision issue when quantize=true; small diffs are noise. We should change the comparator to use `abs(delta) > 0.002` instead of strict equality.

li: good catch. that will cut down on spurious regressions.

maya: action items:
- li to open PR for the GH Actions matrix + runner-health (ETA today)
- dmitri to add comparator change in eval-harness and add `artifact-status` to reporter
- sarah to update dashboard to surface artifact failures and add nightly alert
- infra to investigate token rotation on self-hosted eval-large hosts (cc @infra)

maya: thanks all. tagging this thread for visibility — if infra can confirm token fix we can re-enable full matrix on PRs, otherwise keep PRs to smoke only :thumbsup:
